email.verifySignup.subject: Confirm your Stella sign-up
email.verifySignup.preheader: One tap to finish signing up.
email.verifySignup.title: Confirm your sign-up
email.verifySignup.body: Confirm your email address to start with Stella. Open the link on the device where you are signing up.
email.verifySignup.note: This is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you did not sign up for Stella, you can ignore this email.
email.verifyAddress.subject: Link this address to Stella
email.verifyAddress.preheader: Then you can write to stella@evolsior.com from here.
email.verifyAddress.title: Link this address
email.verifyAddress.body: {email} should be linked to your Stella account. After that you can write to stella@evolsior.com from this address.
email.verifyAddress.note: This is valid for {minutes} minutes. If this was not you, ignore this email.
email.loginLink.subject: Your Stella sign-in link
email.loginLink.preheader: Sign in with one tap, no password needed.

email.loginLink.body: Tap the button to sign in. If you opened the link on another device, you will see a code to type in where you are signing in.
email.loginLink.note: This is valid for {minutes} minutes. If you did not ask for it, you can ignore this email – nobody can sign in without your link.

email.resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
email.resetPassword.body: Tap the button to set a new password for your Stella account.

email.welcome.telegramText: Write to her like to a friend – text, voice messages and photos.
email.welcome.phoneText: Open Stella on your phone and add it to your home screen.
email.welcome.briefingText: Tomorrow morning Stella tells you what the day holds.

email.unknown.body2: Create an account, link this address under Settings, and I will answer your emails.
